expr: var x = 1; var y = 'a'; var result = ''; switch (x) { case 1: result = switch (y) { case 'a' -> '1a'; default -> '1other' }; break; case 2: result = 'two'; break; default: result = 'other'; }; result

expr: var x = 1; var y = 'b'; var result = ''; switch (x) { case 1: result = switch (y) { case 'a' -> '1a'; default -> '1other' }; break; case 2: result = 'two'; break; default: result = 'other'; }; result

expr: var x = 2; var y = 'a'; var result = ''; switch (x) { case 1: result = switch (y) { case 'a' -> '1a'; default -> '1other' }; break; case 2: result = 'two'; break; default: result = 'other'; }; result
